RECORD PLACEMENT + follow-on alarm data (posted retroactively; this ticket is the alarm family's diagnostic home).

Two read-only AWS alarm investigations that continued this ticket's line of work were originally written up as comments on the LLM-gate cost-analysis ticket childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet (a scratchpad placement the operator has since ruled an anti-pattern). Full text now lives in session log cosey-vinegarish-mouflon (d0d8-9dfe-f2d8-4364), entries 3 and 4; the originals remain as childsafe comments 12 and 13.

Substance that bears on THIS ticket's disposition ("accepted, retune only if pager noise becomes a problem"):

- Sweep 2026-08-12T04:00Z->22:45Z: 3 firings into ALARM, ALL TRUE POSITIVES of the same bound-exceeded behavior triaged here (04:01:26Z and 08:27:26Z on the legacy rolled-up alarm; 19:38:49Z on the new reason-scoped rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-bound-exceeded from junco/1650, its first real firing, correctly attributed). No alarm should be tuned for any of them.
- NOISE RATE, so the "revisit with data" clause can be exercised: Aug 1-11 = 6 review-interrupt firings ~= 0.55/day; Aug 12 alone (to 22:45Z) = 4 firings, ~10x the preceding rate, matching the 60+-merge landing burst.
- The important qualifier: all four Aug-12 journal markers cleared the bound by a hair — deferred_for 1810s / 1820s / 1810s / 1930s against bound=1800s (10s, 20s, 10s, 130s over). That points at DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX being marginally undersized for current review durations, NOT at the alarm being too sensitive. A bound raise fixes the true-positive CAUSE rather than loosening a threshold, and would plausibly have prevented all four interrupts (see unskillful-supportive-lion).
- Follow-up pair 23:07Z (rebar-gerrit-voter-errors, rebar-review-bot-merge-change-errors): BOTH FALSE POSITIVES, and the alarms are NOT at fault — the counts were fabricated by probe-side defects in infra/scripts/observability.sh. Filed as widespread-zealous-narwhal (e2a6-9ee4-8d5c-4290, absent-offset cold start) and colossal-slothful-grouse (8c2f-8377-5044-4650, unanchored grep matching the marker vocabulary as data, self-referentially triggered by reviews OF observability.sh).

Nothing was mutated in AWS or on i-00880b2c7f13527c5 during either investigation.
